editorial:
Imagine a time when flying a plane was basically just sitting on a motorized kite and hoping for the best. That is exactly the vibe you get here. You follow a group of eccentric inventors who are all competing in a wild race from London to Paris to win a huge pile of cash. It is a colorful, loud, and lighthearted ride that feels like a giant party. You will love the goofy characters and the way they try to outsmart each other with strange gadgets and makeshift aircraft that look like they might fall apart at any second.

The best part is seeing the physical comedy and the beautiful old-school sets. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the funny rivalry between the pilots keeps you interested. If you like movies that don't take themselves too seriously, you should definitely give this a shot. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but it is also a perfect pick to add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for those crisp, bright colors. Renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to see if you enjoy the style.
endingExplained: In the end, the race becomes a chaotic scramble to the finish line. Percy tries his best to cheat and sabotage the other pilots, but his plans backfire. After a series of crashes and funny mishaps, the most determined pilot finally crosses the line in Paris. The movie wraps up by showing that the spirit of adventure and the joy of inventing were more important than the prize money itself.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-fashioned comedies and aviation history.
